# Google Chrome GUI Interface Description

## System and Window Information

- **Operating System**: Linux (indicated by the "Activities" button in the top-left corner of the screen)
- **Application**: Google Chrome
- **Window Title**: "Google Chrome"
- **Current Tab**: "New Tab"
- **Date and Time**: "Oct 22 23:50" displayed in the top-center of the window
- **System Tray Icons**: Located in the top-right corner, including:
  - Network connectivity icon
  - Sound/volume control icon
  - Power button icon
  - System menu (grid of dots) icon

## Browser Window Components

### Top Toolbar

- **Back Button**: Leftmost button, arrow pointing left
- **Forward Button**: Middle button, arrow pointing right
- **Reload Button**: Rightmost button, circular arrow icon
- **Address Bar**: Long input field with a blue border, currently empty, with a "G" icon on the left
- **Star Icon**: To the right of the address bar, for bookmarking
- **Profile Icon**: A user silhouette icon, indicating user account status
- **Notification Banner**: "New Chrome available" with a small notification icon to its right
- **Menu Button**: Three vertical dots icon, located to the right of the notification banner, which is currently open

### Open Menu (User Menu)

- **Top Notification**: "Chrome is out of date" with a rocket icon
- **Navigation Options**:
  - "New tab" with shortcut "Ctrl+T"
  - "New window" with shortcut "Ctrl+N"
  - "New Incognito window" with shortcut "Ctrl+Shift+N"
- **User Account Section**:
  - "Person 1" with "Not signed in" status
- **Settings and Tools**:
  - "Passwords and autofill"
  - "History"
  - "Downloads" with shortcut "Ctrl+J"
  - "Bookmarks and lists"
  - "Tab groups"
  - "Extensions"
  - "Delete browsing data..." with shortcut "Ctrl+Shift+Del"
- **Zoom Controls**:
  - "Zoom" label
  - Minus button
  - "100%" display
  - Plus button
  - Full-screen toggle button
- **Additional Features**:
  - "Print..." with shortcut "Ctrl+P"
  - "Search with Google Lens"
  - "Translate..."
  - "Find and edit"
  - "Cast, save and share"
  - "More tools"
- **Support and Exit**:
  - "Help"
  - "Settings"
  - "Exit"

## Main Content Area

- **Google Logo**: Centered on the page, multicolored (blue, red, yellow, green)
- **Search Bar**: Large, rounded input field with placeholder text "Search Google or type a URL"
  - **Search Icon**: Magnifying glass on the left
  - **Voice Search Icon**: Microphone icon on the right
  - **Google Lens Icon**: Camera icon on the right
- **Shortcut Buttons**:
  - "Web Store" button with a rainbow icon
  - "Add shortcut" button with a plus sign icon

## Desktop Environment

- **Left Dock**: Vertical application launcher with icons for:
  - Activities
  - Web browser (Firefox)
  - Email client (Thunderbird)
  - Code editor (Visual Studio Code)
  - Media player (VLC)
  - Document editor (LibreOffice Writer)
  - Spreadsheet application (LibreOffice Calc)
  - Presentation software (LibreOffice Impress)
  - Image editor (GIMP)
  - File manager (Nautilus)
  - Software center (Ubuntu Software)
  - Help (Question mark icon)
  - Trash (Recycle bin icon)
- **Bottom Dock**: Grid of nine dots icon for accessing all applications

## Additional UI Elements

- **Customize Chrome Button**: Located at the bottom-right corner of the browser window, with a pencil icon and text "Customise Chrome"
